summary: Tested persistent mining session features. All 16 backend tests PASSED. Fixed bug where boost config was returning tier 0 values instead of correct tier values for 'ultra' plan (missing plan ID mapping). Mining persistence, sync, and boost activation all working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Mining session created for demo user during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Persistent mining fully functional. Mining sessions stored in database and continue even after page refresh/close. Boost config correctly returns tier-based values. Demo user has Ultra Miner (tier 6) with 0.008 base rate, 20s boost duration, 3.0x multiplier, 25s cooldown, 5000 daily limit.

features_tested.details: Returns user mining info, subscription, boost config with correct tier values
Creates persistent mining session in database, returns existing session if already active
Returns current session info with elapsed time, mined amount, boost status
Syncs mining progress, updates FTC balance in mining wallet
Activates speed boost based on subscription tier, respects cooldown
Mining session continues after page refresh, shows 'Mining resumed!' toast
Ultra tier (6) correctly returns: 0.008 rate, 20s duration, 3.0x multiplier, 25s cooldown, 5000 daily limit
Returns 403 error when trying to start mining without active subscription

bug_fixed.description: Boost config was returning tier 0 values for 'ultra' plan because PLAN_TIERS mapping only had 'ultra_2026' key
bug_fixed.root_cause: get_subscription_boost_config() function had PLAN_TIERS mapping with only '_2026' suffixed plan IDs, but subscription stored plan_id as 'ultra' without suffix
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Added non-suffixed plan IDs to PLAN_TIERS mapping (e.g., 'ultra': 6, 'mega': 7, etc.)
bug_fixed.verification: API now returns correct tier 6 config for 'ultra' plan: base_mining_rate=0.008, boost_duration=20, boost_multiplier=3.0

mining_page.mining_active_banner: Shows 'MINING ACTIVE' when session is running
mining_page.boost_info: Shows '20s boost (3.0x speed)' for Ultra tier
mining_page.persistence_message: Shows 'Mining continues even if you close this page!'
mining_page.mining_resumed_toast: Shows 'Mining resumed!' toast on page reload
